anika: Heads-up: scheduling a targeted base-image rebuild + runtime hardening Thurs 02:00-04:00 UTC. Focus: remove Python from base where unused, enable rootless runtime flags, rotate image-signer creds, switch signing to KMS wrap. Affects Dedicated & Private.

sam: Understood. RBAC changes? will this touch workload identity bindings?

anika: We'll create a narrow SA `infra:image-signer` and a Role that only allows reading specific secrets and listing deployments in infra. No cluster-admin. Draft Role: ```yaml
kind: Role
metadata:
  name: image-signer-role
  namespace: infra
rules:
- apiGroups: ["" ]
  resources: ["secrets"]
  verbs: ["get"]
```
Canary will get a RoleBinding scoped to `canary` ns.

maria: Two requirements: 1) audit all signing calls and rolebinding changes to Splunk; 365d retention. 2) preflight vuln-scan must block promotion on any CRITICAL or >3 HIGH.

kevin: For audit we'll add an audit-policy rule matching requests by `system:serviceaccount:infra:image-signer` and rbac API writes. We'll capture RequestBody for those. Also plan a lightweight logging sidecar on the signer to push signing logs to secure-splunk.

liam: KMS note: signer needs `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter` on the specific key. I'll open the IAM ticket. HSM optional later. Signer config snippet: `{"signer":{"kms_key":"projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/images/cryptoKeys/signing-2026","wrap":"kms"}}`

ops: Paging: ops-oncall if signer_error_rate > 1% or p95 latency > 500ms for 5m. We'll pre-create a read-only image cache to avoid pull failures.

sam: CI step: create canary RoleBinding with ephemeral CI creds: `kubectl create rolebinding signer-canary-binding --role=image-signer-role --serviceaccount=infra:image-signer --namespace=canary`. Don't delete old bindings until 48h stable.

maria: I'll add SBOM generation (Syft SPDX) + trivy scan in preflight. Upload SBOM to artifact-store with checksum.

anika: Canary plan: build minimal image -> SBOM -> scan -> deploy to fenced canary -> monitor 24h -> rollback on scan/telemetry fail. Telemetry: signer_latency_p50/p95, image_pull_errors, container_start_failures.

kevin: I'll author the audit-policy PR and add tests asserting audit events include `user=system:serviceaccount:infra:image-signer`.

liam: IAM ticket CLOUD-1799 opened for KMS role grant; ETA 8h.

deploy-bot: Canary scheduled: base-image-rebuild-2026-05-06 at 2026-05-06T02:00:00Z (initiated by anika). Artifact: gcr.io/redwood/base/minimal:20260506-canary.

anika: Thanks. Action items: sam=RBAC playbook + CI job; liam=IAM + signer config; maria=SBOM+scans; kevin=audit-policy PR; ops=on-call + cache. Reconvene Tue EOD for sign-off. :thumbsup:
